Healthcare revenue

Should your practice outsource medical billing?

A practice can keep billing in-house, hand over one queue or outsource a wider portion of the cycle. Identify the actual capacity gap before selecting a model.

In this guide
Find the bottleneckCompare the responsibilitiesStart with a defined scope

Find the bottleneck

Review which claims are waiting, what information they need and which team member can resolve the issue. An external partner may be able to handle payer follow-up, while an unanswered clinical query still needs the provider.

Compare the responsibilities

Document the work retained by the practice, system access, reporting expectations and backup coverage. Ask who handles an urgent issue and how your staff will see open items between reviews.

Start with a defined scope

A pilot can cover one queue, payer group or service line. Record the starting backlog and measures, agree a review date and identify who will take over unfinished work if the arrangement changes.
